## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #177, exact head `b425d072b2bdd3f4b87708cf13c2e70091b13927`.

Reviewed `1d199da..b425d07`, principally the legacy-prime isolation repair; merged #176/#178 additions were scanned for forward exposure, not independently re-reviewed. No high-confidence exploitable security delta was identified. **The new legacy display is not sanitized**, and this verdict does not claim F127 hardening.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new exploitable vulnerability established | - |

### Legacy data and raw presentation

Legacy objects contain stored assignment `seat`, `instance`, `since` and generated `command`, not current seat-reported activity, reasons or cwd (`crates/daemon/src/community/directory.rs:358-367,409-450`). Rebuilt governance holders documents can supply these strings without presentation-control sanitization; historical assignments also copied registered seat identity and supplied instance (`crates/daemon/src/community/holders.rs:301-340`; `directory.rs:744-782,1427-1452`).

The new human legacy line emits seat and command without terminal/Markdown escaping. Instance appears within the command, and invalid timestamp strings are returned unchanged (`crates/cli/src/main.rs:3191-3248,3302-3311`). Historical seat-originated strings can therefore appear raw. The existing holder display already exposed seat/instance/time; this is a new presentation location, not a new live diagnostic-ingestion path.

JSON serialization does not sanitize human presentation or execute shell text (`crates/cli/src/lib.rs:46-61`; `crates/cli/src/main.rs:1839`).

### Repair commands and authority

Every complete release-command argument is POSIX-shell quoted, including the role/instance, seat, project and reason placeholder; embedded apostrophes are escaped (`crates/daemon/src/community/picture.rs:98-104`; `crates/core/src/directory.rs:32-41`). This prevents shell interpretation, not terminal/newline display effects. Subsequent tmux renaming uses argv, argument separation and tmux-format hash escaping.

For prime, legacy assignments cannot contribute to live holders, counts, idle activity or call_on; effective liveness comes solely from the designation (`crates/daemon/src/community/directory.rs:417-429,451-488,521-559`). Assignment still refuses prime before writing (`:1403-1413`). Project-set advice is generated text, not a grant or mutation (`crates/daemon/src/community/picture.rs:447-477`).

### Proof

Prior path-mapping/absence notes stand. No reportable C19/C21 disclosure was identified. GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the full reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42451094504` and latest successful Delivers run `42451094536` both identify this SHA and success; the earlier cancelled Delivers run is superseded.

No local tests, builds, runtime display/role operations, credential reads, mutations or probes were performed.
